Playing the Verge first is marginally better since it keeps the basic Swamp available for future land drops where a basic might matter (e.g., against opposing effects that care about basics, or if you need to play a land that enters tapped unless you control a basic). annotations.description: Kaito is a 3/4 Ninja creature during Haiku Analyst's turn and is attacking (it was put onto the battlefield via ninjutsu or is otherwise in play as a creature). The opponent is at 12 life with an empty board (no creatures). Haiku Analyst chose +1 to get another Ninja emblem, but the 0 ability would Surveil 2 and then draw a card for each opponent who lost life this turn. Since Kaito is attacking and presumably dealt combat damage (or will deal combat damage), the 0 ability would draw cards after combat. However, this is precombat main phase - combat hasn't happened yet, so no opponent has lost life this turn. Still, the +1 emblem only matters for Ninjas, and Kaito is the only Ninja. Getting another +1/+1 emblem (possibly already has one) makes Kaito slightly bigger, but Surveil 2 provides card quality which is more valuable when you only have No More Lies in hand and need to find threats/answers. At 9 life vs 12 life with the opponent having an empty board, card selection via Surveil 2 is significantly more valuable than a redundant +1/+1 emblem (Kaito would already be at least 4/5 with one emblem, making it 5/6 doesn't meaningfully change the clock). The 0 ability should have been used precombat for the Surveil 2 to improve draws, then after combat damage Kaito would have dealt damage and the draw-a-card clause would have applied if used post-combat instead. Actually, since this is precombat, using 0 now gives Surveil 2 but no card draw (no life lost yet). Using +1 precombat then using 0 next turn post-combat would be better sequencing... but Kaito can only activate one loyalty ability per turn. The better play would be to attack first, deal combat damage (opponent loses life), then use the 0 ability post-combat to Surveil 2 AND draw a card. Using +1 precombat wastes the opportunity to draw a card this turn.

annotations.betterLine: Attack with Kaito and Sunpearl Kirin first, deal combat damage to make the opponent lose life, then activate Kaito's 0 ability post-combat to Surveil 2 and draw a card (since the opponent lost life this turn). With only No More Lies in hand, drawing a card is far more valuable than a redundant +1/+1 emblem.
